x: There was a good smattering of youth in the team, all of whom scored well - Phillip Idowu, Mat George, Andrew Hill - and two new members - thrower Kevin Stock and steeplechaser Jean-Marie Bart.
Phillip Idowu got up to 8th in the Inter Boy's triple jump but Syful Ahmed had the galling experience of travelling all the way to Nottingham to produce three no jumps!

Probably the best event of the day for talent in both 'A' and 'B' strings was the triple jump where Philip Idowu and Sayful Ahmed both leapt the sort of distances that will soon be taking them into the senior teams.

Sixteen year-old Geoffrey Ojok again tackled the long jump and relay and he was joined by fellow McDonalds stars Marlon Dickson, who was entrusted with last leg in the 4 x 100m, James Hilston, on a low 48 split in the 4 x 400m, and Phillip Idowu in the triple jump.
Sixteen year-old Phillip Idowu just missed out on the medals in the triple jump but his 13.90 quite clearly made him the Belgrave No. 2 in the event for 1995.
But perhaps the star of the day was Philip Idowu whose 14.68 triple jump so early in the season was a clear indication that he'll be over 15m in a month or two.

It was good to see new Belgravians Lee Newman, Tom Lerwill, Dave Smith, Chris Rawlinson and Andy Walcott scoring heavily and our team is beginning to have a distinctly youthful look when you stir in the mix of Juniors Philip Idowu, Geoffrey Ojok, James Hilston and Richard Aspden.
Andrew Goudie ~ 1st English Schools 5k Walk; 1st SEAA Champs.; 2nd SRWA; 1st Kent AA; AAA Grade I 10k Walk. Phillip Idowu ~ 2nd English Schools Triple Jump; 2nd SEAA.
Philip Idowu looked tired at the end of a tong season but Marlon Dickson looked better than ever, running both relays. Even he was surprised how easy a 49.1 leg felt.

Michael had already impressed with his 48.9 individual win while Steve Scott's 14.3 sprint hurdles victory took him to the top of the national rankings for the year. But it was Phillip Idowu's performance that was rated most highly as he leapt out to 15 metres for the second week in a row.

Maximum points in the discus, high jump, and shot backed up by individual wins from Darrell Maynard ('A' 800), Matt Douglas ('B' 400), Justin Chaston ('A' 3000 s/c), James Hilston ('B' 400) and Philip Idowu ('A' triple jump) moved us well clear of the opposition.

Phil' Idowu, Austin Ferns, Marlon Dickson, Chris' Lambert, Marlon Kerr, Charles Igbon, Samson Oni, Matt' Russell, Darren Thompson... All of these and more athletes have enjoyed regular appearances in our showcase team either in League or Cup contests.
